title: Quick Mode + Titan At A Glance
summary: Quick Mode is now a complete optional app experience, with the Titan Pie and This Week Command Centre while Classic Mode remains available.
details: Quick Mode reduces navigation density without removing intelligence, records, genetics, reminders, learning, community or any underlying feature.
The full Quick Mode toolbox exposes every major app area from one searchable, grouped entry point — specialist Creator, Tester and Educator tools remain permission-aware.
The Titan Pie gives you 4–6 configurable live shortcuts that can be reordered and changed to fit your routine.
Titan Week has its own full page with current and historical weeks, configurable week starts, weekly metrics, per-Titan targets and direct actions.
Classic Mode remains available in Personalise Experience for users who prefer the existing navigation model.

whereToFind.label: Enable Quick Mode
whereToFind.hint: My Account → Personalise Experience → App Experience → Quick Mode

whereToFind.label: Open Titan Week
whereToFind.hint: Titan Pie → This Week, or the dedicated Titan Week Command Centre

steps.title: Open Everything
steps.instruction: Tap the glowing Everything button to open Tiny Titans' full Quick Mode menu.

steps.title: Open My Account
steps.instruction: Now tap the glowing My Account entry inside the full menu.

steps.title: Personalise your experience
steps.instruction: In My Account, tap Personalise Experience.

steps.title: Choose Quick Mode
steps.instruction: Finally, tap the glowing Quick Mode option. That's it — your full app is now in Quick Mode.
